title: Text hierarchy

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Specify different spacing for headings and continuous text because compact emphasis and sustained reading have different needs.
strategic_value: Shared heading/body spacing can give Helsinki publications a consistent rhythm.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section compares heading and body specimens with 100% and 120% line-spacing instructions and an Arial fallback.
practical_value: Set heading leading equal to type size and body leading to 120%, then compare the resulting hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Heading rule
content_islands.spec: Give the equal point-size/leading instruction and example.

content_islands.name: Body rule
content_islands.spec: Give 120% leading and its numerical example.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy specimens
content_islands.spec: Show the relative heading/body sizes below with the fallback caption.

ingredient.name: Heading and body leading
ingredient.role: Separate compact emphasis from readable paragraphs.
ingredient.application: Use 100% leading for headings and 120% for body text, such as 30/30 pt and 10/12 pt.
ingredient.scope: These are leading ratios; the page’s specimen sizes do not establish a universal fixed type scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The specimens illustrate relative heading and body sizes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Heading leading equals type size; body leading is 120%; Arial substitutes when Helsinki Grotesk is unavailable.
